credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/fireweed.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LOOMING: a tall spike on willow-leaf arms; the magenta flowers open bottom-up (open below, closed buds nodding at the tip, as on the real raceme), and under them the oldest pods have split into two plumes of white seed fluff. Gesture: the plumes swell, then release a volley of seeds that drifts up past the flowers. Sport: f. albiflorum (white flowers, green stems).
